description: This file contains C# interface and class definitions related to Orleans grain interfaces for testing code generation, serializers, equality comparers, and data structures used within a Orleans-based project.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Serializer-marked classes Command within namespaces One and Two used for grain method parameters.

classes.name: Outsider
classes.description: A simple class marked with GenerateSerializer attribute.

classes.name: CaseInsensitiveStringEquality
classes.description: EqualityComparer for strings ignoring case, used for serialization testing.

classes.name: Mod5IntegerComparer
classes.description: EqualityComparer for integers based on mod 5 comparison, used for serialization testing.

classes.name: CaseInsensitiveStringComparer
classes.description: Comparer for strings ignoring case, used for serialization testing.

classes.name: RootType
classes.description: A serializable class that contains a dictionary of string to object, with custom equality logic.

classes.name: SomeStruct
classes.description: A serializable struct with multiple fields, including guid, integers, references, and private members.

classes.name: ISomeInterface
classes.description: Interface with a single integer property, used as a reference type for serialization.

classes.name: SomeAbstractClass
classes.description: A serializable abstract class implementing ISomeInterface, with various data members, including enums and grain references.

classes.name: AnotherConcreteClass
classes.description: A concrete implementation of SomeAbstractClass, with additional string property.

classes.name: InnerType
classes.description: A serializable class with GUID and string, with proper equality implementation.

classes.name: ClassWithStructConstraint
classes.description: A generic class constrained to value types, with a single value property.

classes.name: ClassWithNestedPrivateClassInListField
classes.description: A class containing a private nested class, illustrating serialization constraints.

classes.name: ReadOnlyStructWithReadOnlyArray
classes.description: A readonly struct that contains a readonly byte array, demonstrating serialization of readonly members.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Override to compare RootType instances based on their dictionaries.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Override to provide hash code for RootType.

methods.name: GetValueWithPrivateGetter
methods.description: Returns private getter value of SomeStruct.
